name: Jellyfin Music
author: Andreas Bylund
description: Play music from your Jellyfin server straight from the Omarchy bar, through mpv.

barWidget.description: Now playing, transport controls, and quick picks from your Jellyfin music library. Streams to a local mpv, so the track also appears on MPRIS and the media keys work.

schema.label: Show the track title in the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the music icon. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.

schema.label: Scroll the title in the bar
schema.description: Off holds a long title still and shortens it instead. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.

schema.label: Track title width in the bar
schema.description: How much room the title gets next to the icon. Use the toggle above to turn it off entirely.

schema.label: Show album art
schema.description: Cover image next to the current track. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.

schema.label: Album artists only
schema.description: Hide collaboration splits like 'A & B' from Artists and search. Their tracks already sit under the main artist. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.
